heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy north, with occasional sun, more sun south. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s, rising into the mid to upper 50s in the southern valleys. West to southwest wind at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy. Lows from the upper 20s to low 30s, mid to upper 30s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Thursday
text: A mix of sun and clouds, with more sun developing through the afternoon. Highs in the mid to upper 50s. Calm wind, speeds increasing to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley, with gusts up to 20 mph.
